name: Zip-Codes.com ZIP & Postal Code MCP
description: Location intelligence for US addresses and ZIP Codes: standardize a US address to ZIP+4, look up US ZIP and Canadian postal codes, search by radius, measure distance and get census tract demographics and district overlaps. Without a key it runs in demo mode: real values, deeper fields withheld except on demo values. A free key (X-Api-Key, 2,500 credits a day) removes the masking. Agents with an MPP wallet can buy a prepaid API key through buy_credits; the wallet's owner approves each payment.
author: Zip-Codes.com
